🎙️ Journalists are invited to meet astronaut Sophie Adenot at our Headquarters in Paris on 2 November at 11:30 CET, for her first in-person press conference since returning from the International Space Station.

Accreditation is open until 29 October: https://t.co/xjHOCuipf4 https://t.co/D7tq9GK17i

Have you put up your Halloween decor? The night sky will add the finishing touch. 🌕
 
October’s full moon, named the Hunter’s Moon, will rise on the night of Oct. 26. Its name comes from the seasonal practice of hunters relying on bright moonlight. https://t.co/hcfQREMJOq
